rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something before anything else.

example.english: Let’s eat first, then go shopping.
example.traditional: 我哋先食飯，再去行街啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 sik6 faan6 zoi3 heoi3 haang4 gaai1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for “firstly” when presenting points in an ordered list or argument.

example.english: First, we need to sort out the budget.
example.traditional: 第一，我哋要先搞掂預算。
example.jyutping: dai6 jat1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 gaau2 dim6 jyu6 syun3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being number one in an ordered series, such as being the first person to arrive.

example.english: I was the first to arrive at the office.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 go3 dou3 gung1 si1

rows.note: Use this for the earliest or initial stage in time rather than the ordinal number one.

example.english: At first, I wasn't used to this job.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 co1 m4 zaap6 gwaan3 ni1 fan6 gung1

rows.note: Use this when saying that something happened for the first time.

example.english: The first time I went to Japan, everything felt new.
example.traditional: 我第一次去日本嗰陣，乜都覺得新鮮。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 go2 zan6 mat1 dou1 gok3 dak1 san1 sin1

rows.note: Use this when “first” means the most eminent or excellent person in a field.

example.english: They are the first in the team when it comes to talent.
example.traditional: 佢係隊入面最出色嗰個。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 deoi6 jap6 min6 zeoi3 ceot1 sik1 go2 go3

rows.note: Use this for the highest position or rank rather than the greatest ability or excellence.

example.english: This is the first position in the company hierarchy.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gou1 zik1 wai2
